verdict.rationale: Parahelp offers simulation-based testing against historical tickets, automations that watch tools/queues to 'surface gaps on their own,' and a way to prompt the Internal Agent for a report on where the Customer Agent falls short — feeding into new configuration releases that can be tracked/reverted. This covers a gap-identification-and-fix loop but doesn't show explicit scored sampling of live conversations or a formal failure-flagging/QA scorecard process. Missing for 10: evidence of systematic scoring rubrics for conversation samples, explicit failure-flagging UI/workflow distinct from gap-report prompts, and independent corroboration of the QA loop in practice.
